Author: Deepak Verma
Bench: Deepak Verma
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 78
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 48712 of 2022
Applicant :- Saripalli Prasad Babu

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sitendra Singh,Narendra Kumar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release him on
bail in Case Crime No. 224 of 2022, under Sections 420, 406, 408 I.P.C., P.S. Sarsawa, District
Saharanpur, during pendency of the trial.

It is alleged in the F.I.R. that applicant had been appointed as sales marketing officer in the
informant's company and was given a mobile phone with sim card for dealing the work of company
but applicant put personal sim card in mobile phone and disclosed the details of the company to
other person.
Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the present case.

The applicant has not disclosed the confidential information of the Saripalli Prasad Babu vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101481875/
1 company to the other persons.

entities.text: Saripalli Prasad Babu vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The allegation is bogus and without any evidence.
The applicant has no criminal history.
Moreover, there is no prospect of trial of the present case being concluded in near future.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 30.05.2022 and in case he is enlarged on bail he will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the bail prayer of the applicant.

Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case and the law laid down by the Apex Court in Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant, Saripalli Prasad Babu, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
2. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
3. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
